newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: S.Korea's Hyundai Oil mulls refinery expansion.
newsitem.headline: S.Korea's Hyundai Oil mulls refinery expansion.

text.p: South Korea's Hyundai Oil Refinery Co, an affiliate of Hyundai Group, is considering expanding its daily refining capacity by 300,000 barrels (bpd) by 2005, company officials said on Monday.
"We are considering building a new 300,000 bpd refinery by 2005," one Hyundai official said.
The expansion would boost Hyundai's oil refining capacity to 610,000 bpd from the current 310,000 bpd. At present, South Korea's total refining capacity stands at 2.44 million bpd.
